budget: 3 cases*(1 baseline+6 generations)*64*128=172032 search; up to3 cases*2 seeds*2 arms*64*128=98304 confirmation; cap270336. Separate completed engineering12288; total new cap282624. All ordinary and ended padding rows charged.
confirmation: Only cases with a search positive get2 new reset seeds, fixed selected prefix versus base;24 repeated slots each, require >=20 short positives and more than base for BOTH seeds. Do not claim24 independent source cases or full-course recovery.

evaluation_template.scope: Bounded TRAIN-source short recovery search or new-reset confirmation; never held-out qualification. Prefix ends after12 controls, all rows charged. Preserve original state, action limits and failure rules.

method: 24 candidates per generation (0=zero prefix,1=incumbent,22 Gaussian samples),3x12 piecewise constant residual coordinates added to frozen PPO for12 controls, clipped at existing absolute action bounds; afterward frozen PPO only. Stable elite rank, mean/std from6 elites, no weight updates.
next_stage: Only confirmed short positives can justify separately registered full-course follow-through and exploration-learning experiments; no held-out sources or FlowDAgger integration in this run.
scoring: 1000*short_positive +2*active_controls -mean_tilt_deg +0.5*longest_post_handoff_upright. Short positive: survives128 controls or completes course, with a25-control <=10deg window after handoff containing >=5 controls with at least2 feet world Fz>5N.
selection: Training search incumbent with highest score across preregistered generations, stable first occurrence on ties; retain all proposals/failures. This is paid search selection, not checkpoint selection from evaluation. No further tuning or replacement seeds.
